CPP_NO_GOTO.message: Usage of 'goto' breaks structured programming principles and makes control flow harder to maintain.
CPP_NO_GOTO.remediation: Replace 'goto' with structured control constructs such as loops or functions.

CPP_VAR_NAMING.message: Variable name '{name}' does not follow recommended naming conventions.
CPP_VAR_NAMING.remediation: Use lowerCamelCase for variable names and avoid unnecessary uppercase letters.

CPP_MAGIC_NUMBER.message: Magic number '{value}' detected. Consider defining it as a named constant.
CPP_MAGIC_NUMBER.remediation: Define a named constant instead of using raw numeric literals.

CPP_SWITCH_NO_DEFAULT.message: Switch statement has no default branch.
CPP_SWITCH_NO_DEFAULT.remediation: Add a default case to handle unexpected values.

CPP_NAMESPACE_USING_IN_HEADER.message: Using 'using namespace' at global scope can pollute the global namespace and cause name conflicts.
CPP_NAMESPACE_USING_IN_HEADER.remediation: Avoid using 'using namespace' in headers; instead qualify names explicitly or limit 'using' directives to implementation files or local scopes.

CPP_LOGIC_RETURN_VALUE_IGNORED.message: Function return value is not used; it may indicate an error or important state.
CPP_LOGIC_RETURN_VALUE_IGNORED.remediation: Check the return value or explicitly cast to void if ignoring is intentional.

CPP_LOGIC_GLOBAL_VARIABLE_ABUSE.message: Global variable increases coupling and makes code harder to test.
CPP_LOGIC_GLOBAL_VARIABLE_ABUSE.remediation: Prefer local variables or pass data via parameters.

CPP_CLASS_MEMBER_INITIALIZATION_ORDER.message: Initializer list order should match member declaration order.
CPP_CLASS_MEMBER_INITIALIZATION_ORDER.remediation: Reorder the initializer list to match the order of member declarations.

CPP_CLASS_MEMBER_FUNCTION_HIDING.message: Derived class function hides base class function; add override if intended to override.
CPP_CLASS_MEMBER_FUNCTION_HIDING.remediation: Use override keyword or different name to avoid accidental hiding.

CPP_FUNCTION_UNUSED_PARAMETER.message: Parameter is declared but never used.
CPP_FUNCTION_UNUSED_PARAMETER.remediation: Remove the parameter or mark it with (void)param or [[maybe_unused]].

CPP_LOGIC_COMPARISON_OF_UNRELATED_TYPES.message: Comparing pointer with integer or unrelated types may be unintentional.
CPP_LOGIC_COMPARISON_OF_UNRELATED_TYPES.remediation: Ensure both operands have compatible types for meaningful comparison.

CPP_LOGIC_ARRAY_INITIALIZATION_INCOMPLET.message: Array has more elements than initializers; remaining elements are zero-initialized or indeterminate.
CPP_LOGIC_ARRAY_INITIALIZATION_INCOMPLET.remediation: Provide initializers for all elements or use fewer elements in the declaration.

CPP_LOGIC_INFINITE_LOOP_RISK.message: Loop condition may never become false; consider adding a break or modifying the condition.
CPP_LOGIC_INFINITE_LOOP_RISK.remediation: Ensure the loop has a reachable exit condition.

CPP_INCLUDE_GUARD_MISSING.message: Header file may lack include guards, leading to redefinition errors.
CPP_INCLUDE_GUARD_MISSING.remediation: Add #ifndef/#define/#endif or #pragma once at the top of the header.

CPP_MACRO_PARAMETER_NO_PARENS.message: Macro parameter used without parentheses can cause operator precedence bugs.
CPP_MACRO_PARAMETER_NO_PARENS.remediation: Wrap each macro parameter in parentheses: #define FOO(x) ((x) + 1).

CPP_MACRO_WITH_SIDE_EFFECTS.message: Macro expands argument multiple times; side effects (e.g. i++) may run more than once.
CPP_MACRO_WITH_SIDE_EFFECTS.remediation: Use inline function or ensure macro arguments have no side effects.

CPP_MACRO_REDEFINITION.message: Macro is defined more than once; later definition may override earlier one.
CPP_MACRO_REDEFINITION.remediation: Use #ifndef to guard macro definitions or #undef before redefining.

CPP_TYPE_NARROWING_CONVERSION.message: Conversion may lose precision or range (e.g. double to int).
CPP_TYPE_NARROWING_CONVERSION.remediation: Use explicit cast or ensure source value is within target range.

CPP_FUNCTION_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_VALUE_RED.message: Default parameter specified in both declaration and definition.
CPP_FUNCTION_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_VALUE_RED.remediation: Specify default values only in the declaration.
